invariants_acknowledged: All three trigger types (entity event, schedule, webhook) must execute in this PR; no trigger type may be saved without a runtime that acts on it (owner ruling 1).
Rules execute inside the API process: in-process bus intake buffers only and never throws, a locked interval runner executes durable run rows (owner ruling 2, ADR-084).
Every query passes tenantId explicitly; the engine takes the tenant only from the record, schedule or webhook-token row; foreign ids give NOT_FOUND with no write.
Webhook signing secrets are encrypted at rest and URL tokens stored only as SHA-256; neither appears in outputs, logs, audit entries, run rows or Sentry events.
Destructive and multi-row writes run in $transaction; never skipDuplicates; P2002 -> CONFLICT; P2025 -> NOT_FOUND (playbook section 5).
Page follows the module-settings playbook: PageHeader + 12-col bento, shared SectionHeader action slot, passive EmptyState entity=rules, Button size=sm Title Case, TagsTab via forwardRef.
Every Boolean toggle is category 1 (wired now); no AI toggles exist (AI defaults FALSE = N/A).
The one Prisma migration is additive Class A with no backfill; it is applied to production only by the runner after merge (L13).
Lead conversion fires lead.converted rules only; task events are never triggers; assignees see owned or assigned tasks (owner rulings 4, 6, 7).
